title: UX is ten real pages, cards breathe, reject on hover

text: The tab strip is gone: UX expands in the rail to its ten modules, the index is a wall of ten cards. The docs/open gap was literally zero (a CSS hack computing to nothing) and compact padding was starved by the wrong token — both fixed and measured. Hover a card, press the flag, type one line: it reaches the mastermind.
